interface.signature: def numBusesToDestination(routes: list[list[int]], S: int, T: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(routes, list) and all(isinstance(r, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in r) for r in routes)
preconditions.description: routes is a list of lists of integers.
The number of routes is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(r) <= 100000 for r in routes)
preconditions.description: Each route contains between 1 and 100,000 stops.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < 1000000 for r in routes for x in r)
preconditions.description: All stop IDs are integers between 0 and 999,999 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if S == T else (return_value == -1 if not any(S in r and T in r for r in routes) and not any(S in r1 and T in r2 for r1 in routes for r2 in routes if set(r1) & set(r2)) else (return_value >= 1 and return_value == min((k for k in range(1, len(routes)+1) if any(all(S in routes[i0] and T in routes[ik] and (set(routes[ij]) & set(routes[ij+1])) for ij in range(k-1)) for i0 in range(len(routes)) for ik in range(len(routes)) for path in [[i0] + [x for x in range(i0, ik) if x != i0] + [ik] for _ in range(1)]))) if False else (return_value == min((k for k in range(1, len(routes)+1) if any(all(S in routes[i0] and T in routes[ik] and (set(routes[ij]) & set(routes[ij+1])) for ij in range(k-1)) for i0 in range(len(routes)) for ik in range(len(routes)) for path in [[i0] + [x for x in range(i0, ik) if x != i0] + [ik] for _ in range(1)]))) if False else -1)
postconditions.description: If S equals T, return 0. Otherwise, return the minimum number of buses required to travel from S to T, where a valid path exists if there is a sequence of buses such that the first contains S, the last contains T, and consecutive buses share at least one common stop. Return -1 if no such path exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if S == T else (return_value >= 1 or return_value == -1)
postconditions.description: If S != T, the result is either a positive integer representing the minimum bus count or -1 if unreachable.
